description: Unit tests for Qpack header table implementations in QUIC, including encoder and decoder header tables, testing insertion, eviction, capacity adjustments, and observer notifications.

classes.name: QpackHeaderTableTest
classes.description: Template base class for testing Qpack header tables, providing setup and utility methods.

classes.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTableTest
classes.description: Test fixture for QpackEncoderHeaderTable, includes header field matching and eviction tests.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTableTest
classes.description: Test fixture for QpackDecoderHeaderTable, includes entry lookup, insertion, eviction, and observer tests.

classes.name: MockObserver
classes.description: Mock class for testing observer notifications in header tables.

methods.name: ExpectMatch
methods.description: Checks if header field matches expected static/dynamic table entry.

methods.name: ExpectNoMatch
methods.description: Checks that header field does not match any entry.

methods.name: MaxInsertSizeWithoutEvictingGivenEntry
methods.description: Returns maximum size of an entry that can be inserted without eviction.

methods.name: draining_index
methods.description: Calculates index for draining entries based on fraction.

methods.name: ExpectEntryAtIndex
methods.description: Verifies entry at given index matches expected name and value.

methods.name: ExpectNoEntryAtIndex
methods.description: Verifies no entry exists at given index.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for insert count threshold.
